visualFindings.finding: All eight frozen Chromium phone originals show one unbroken chrome silhouette. The broad lower material curves into the sides and tapers toward the top; no prior segmented joints, brackets, rivets, notches or slab pedestal remain. The final curved reflection has no previous horizontal black band or repeated dark columns.

Fine bright ice core is visibly distinct inside the thicker sapphire glass at both sizes. Navy and royal blue retain saturated depth without a cyan wash; emerald and ruby remain sport specific. Local travelling glints preserve fixed material geometry.
Blue stays on the left and red on the right through the ring, venue and corridor. The centred hue boundary is a light treatment, not a physical break in the connected chrome casting.

Compared personally with all eight prior published originals, the smaller league marks leave substantially more seating, field/court and UFC cage visible. NFL yard line, NRL goal/playing surface, NBA centre court and UFC octagon remain legible. Photography-like decorative venue artwork is cover-cropped rather than stretched; league marks remain contained with native proportions.

No uncovered venue gap or aliased raster casting edge is apparent in reviewed phone originals. The stage, physical optical path and vector housing share the same aspect ratio and coordinates. Chrome shading remains neutral in all four sport states.

functionalEvidenceInterpretation: Closed Chromium report records native sport selection and keyboard navigation, Coming soon entry restrictions, NFL entry and return, existing NFL/team/matchup navigation and direct-route reloads. The phone contexts each contain36 recorded native actions; motion and inactivity/reduced-resume contracts passed. This review read those genuine recorded outcomes rather than substituting a static SVG validator for browser behaviour.
